components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Switches sample, criterion or grouping; the selected segment is solid ink.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid #c6c9ce;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;font:520 13px 'Libre Franklin',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-seg button{border:0;border-left:1px solid #e1e2e4;background:transparent;padding:0 10px;height:28px;color:#464b55}.ds-seg button:first-child{border-left:0}.ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#16181d;color:#fcfcfb}.ds-seg span{opacity:.7;margin-left:4px}

components.name: Highlighted message line
components.description: Numbered source line in the record face with a hook span and a reviewer quote.
components.html: 3Next: shipitnowafterCI then report back.

components.name: Citation
components.description: Line and column of a highlight; clicking jumps to it.

narrative.overview: Exact message text beside every judgment of it. Messages in a typewriter face in numbered lines, highlights cited by line and column, figures with numerator, denominator and interval. Ink on a near-neutral ground with hairlines; colour only for meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Every share carries k/n and its sample

rules.name: The one-meaning rule
rules.body: Blue is the hook, magenta is the reviewers, the four-step scale is the rubric, grey is unknown. Nothing else gets a hue.

rules.name: The denominator rule
rules.body: A share is never shown without k/n and the sample it describes.

rules.name: The record rule
rules.body: Text that is the record (messages, quotes, identifiers) is set in Courier Prime; commentary is set in Libre Franklin.

dos: Cite every highlight by line and column
Name the sample under every figure
donts: Decorate with paper texture or legal wording
Use a meaning colour for links or hover
